title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six

result.label: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six
result.statement: Proves the Campana–Peternell conjecture in complex dimension six: every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous.
